stem: Plants wilt even though the media remains saturated, and roots show declining condition. What is the strongest first management response?
choices: Add irrigation because leaf wilt under saturated conditions most likely indicates the crop is still water deficient
Increase nutrient concentration because weak roots need a stronger solution to restore normal water uptake
Investigate drainage, aeration, and root health before treating the wilt as a simple water shortage
Reduce canopy lighting because saturated media indicates the root system is functioning normally and demand is excessive
rationale: Wilting can occur when damaged or oxygen-limited roots cannot function normally despite abundant water. Root-zone aeration, drainage, and root condition should be evaluated before adding more water.
